content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The farm-specific styling works, but the empty space above the hero text and oversized signpost make the opening screen unnecessarily tall.",
  "desktopNote": "The cohesive alpine identity feels bespoke, but the oversized headline and heavy image overlay overpower the mountain view.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 4,
    "distinctiveness": 5
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 4,
    "distinctiveness": 5
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Compact the phone hero by reducing its top padding and shrinking the signpost; make the room photo below span the available content width instead of leaving a large empty strip beside it.",
    "Reduce the desktop hero headline size and move the reservation action higher so the landscape has more room to breathe.",
    "Replace the uniformly dark hero overlay with a stronger gradient behind the text and a lighter treatment over the unobstructed landscape."
  ]
}
